Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes — damaged items are handled differently from normal returns. 
Damaged items:
• Report the issue within 7 days of delivery.
• Send photos of the damaged item and the packaging (and the packing slip if possible).
• Keep the item in the condition you received it.
• The photos help verify what happened and allow the case to be reviewed for a possible resolution. 
Normal returns:
• Returns are not accepted for change of mind or taste once the order has been delivered. 
So if something arrives damaged, the process focuses on photos and reporting the issue, rather than a standard return request.
